bass.tags: Lo-fi hip hop instrumental. A dusty, sampled acoustic piano plays a repetitive four-bar progression featuring jazz-influenced seventh chords. The drum kit consists of a muffled, thumping kick drum and a crisp, slightly off-grid snare with a high-frequency roll-off. A subtle, melodic electric bass follows the piano's root notes with occasional syncopated passing tones. Atmospheric vinyl crackle and a low-level hiss persist throughout the track. A recurring three-note Rhodes electric piano motif appears in the higher register. 88 BPM, C Minor, 4/4 time.

drums.tags: Indie rock. Clean electric guitar plays a repetitive, syncopated arpeggiated riff in 4/4 time. A melodic electric bass line enters, playing eighth-note patterns that outline the chord progression. The drum kit features a steady kick on every beat with a crisp snare on the backbeat and consistent eighth-note closed hi-hats. A second electric guitar provides ambient, sustained melodic fills with light overdrive and reverb. The arrangement maintains a consistent dynamic level throughout the excerpt. Key of G Major. Tempo is 124 BPM.
